'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 2 Kevin Shannon LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Karrdeshark
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
